Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to move forward with the two-week pilot (production subset) and have one initial invoice that covers setup + first-month usage. Appreciate the quick turnaround — our billing runs next Friday.

Subject: Fwd: Request — pilot onboarding without PO for first invoice (proposal for controls)

Forwarding BlueFjord's request. Proposal (for procurement/finance review):

- Temporary invoice-only carveout: 60 days maximum from onboarding date.
- Single invoice cap: up to $25,000 for the initial invoice (covers setup + month 1).
- Required evidence up front: signed SOW, W9, certificate of insurance (COI) if services > $10k, point-of-contact for AP.
- Controls: vendor placed on temporary allowlist, invoices routed to finance with GL code provided, monthly reconciliation and PO issuance in parallel.
- Escalation: any invoice above $25k or failure to produce required docs -> auto-escalate to Procurement Director for PO enforcement.

Attachments: Procurement_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx (draft)

Can you confirm whether procurement accepts these guardrails? If so I'll confirm to BlueFjord and request their AP routing details.

Thanks,
Dylan
[attachment: Procurement_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

Dylan —

We can approve a time-limited, invoice-only path with the controls you proposed but with the following conditions: 

1) Limit: 60 days maximum; single-invoice hard cap at $20,000 (we went conservative given pilot risk).
2) Legal must sign off on the SOW addendum confirming scope + payment terms (I’ve copied Priyom for legal intake).
3) Finance (Marissa) needs AP contact and preferred invoice format; all invoices must include our temporary vendor code and GL string for reconciliation.
4) Procurement will add BlueFjord to the temporary allowlist and set an auto-review trigger at $5k+ per invoice for closer scrutiny.
5) Required evidence: signed SOW, W9 (received), COI if services exceed $10k (request from vendor now), and completed Procurement_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx.

I attached the procurement checklist (finalized). Once we have legal sign-off and the COI (if needed), Procurement will authorize and notify Finance to accept the single invoice. If BlueFjord cannot supply COI and legal declines the addendum, we revert to PO-first.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
